# Manifest

> Manifest is the skydive app for iPhone (the app for skydivers) and the system for dropzones. The iPhone app shows live loads from 150+ dropzones, used by jumpers in 38 countries, records a jump from your pocket and replays the whole flight in 3D over real terrain, and covers weather, gear reminders, a logbook with in-person sign-offs, dropzones and community. Manifest Desk is browser-based manifest software for dropzones, connected live to the app. The app is free to download. Made by Manifest Jump LLC (Wyoming, USA).

## Who it is for
- Skydivers (fun jumpers): anyone who jumps at a dropzone and wants live loads, 3D replays of their jumps and their jump records on their phone.
- Dropzone owners and manifest staff: Manifest Desk runs loads, money, staff and safety, and puts every load call on every jumper's phone.

## Why Manifest is different: one connected loop
Most dropzone software only runs the desk, and most skydiving apps only record jumps. Manifest connects the whole jump day in one live system:
1. The jumper already carries the Manifest app (live loads, 3D replays) and manifests themselves onto a load from their phone.
2. The dropzone sees it instantly on Manifest Desk and stays in control: staff move people between loads, run standby and approve every slot.
3. Payments land in the dropzone's own Stripe account (Apple Pay top-ups), so Manifest never holds the dropzone's money.
4. Load calls (called, 10 minutes, 5 minutes, boarding, holds) reach every jumper on the load on their Lock Screen the moment staff press the button.
5. Safety stays shared: the desk sees who is on which load, who is back after the jump, and any landout on a live map.

## How landout location sharing works
- Manifest does not track jumpers for the dropzone during the jump. Location is shared with the desk only when the jumper asks for help.
- After landing, the jumper taps "Landed out?" (in the app or from the Lock Screen) and picks how they are: injured, need a ride, or walking back.
- The phone sends its GPS position, and keeps updating it while the help call is open, so staff see a live dot on a satellite map with the distance from the dropzone.
- The desk can send a pickup pin to a driver, show the jumper who is coming and their ETA, call the jumper, and put every load on hold with one tap. The emergency contact is shown only when the jumper is injured.
- Sharing stops when the call is resolved or the jumper taps "I'm back". It supports the dropzone's own emergency procedures; it is not a guaranteed rescue tracker, since it depends on the phone's battery, GPS and signal.

## What the app does (iPhone, free to download)
- Live loads: the loads turning right now at 220+ dropzones in 38 countries, who is on them and the minutes to call, read from each dropzone's own manifest.
- 3D jump replay (free): record a jump with the phone in your pocket and replay the whole flight in 3D over real terrain, from the climb to the landing, using the phone's GPS and barometer. No extra hardware.
- Logbook with sign-offs: another licensed jumper who was there scans your QR and signs the jump off in person; their name and licence number go on the entry. Records the fields USPA SIM 3-1 requires. Import past jumps from CSV.
- Check-in Pass and Apple Wallet pass: licence, currency, jump numbers and gear service in one scannable view.
- Weather and winds for jumping, gear and reserve repack reminders, dropzone finder, events, coaches, messaging and community.
- Works offline: log with no signal, it syncs later.

## Manifest Pro (optional, paid in the app)
- Your load on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with gear-up and final-call notifications. Free at Manifest Desk dropzones.
- A recorder that arms itself when your load takes off, cloud backup of tracks, replay stats, jump receipt, track and PDF exports.
- Yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

## Manifest Desk (for dropzones)
- Manifest software in the browser at https://desk.jumpmanifest.com: loads, standby, jumper accounts and balances, staff, aircraft and a hangar TV board.
- Load calls pushed to every jumper's Lock Screen with one button.
- Landouts on a live map with a pickup pin for the driver, and one tap to put every load on hold.
- Jumpers self-manifest and top up with Apple Pay; the money goes straight to the dropzone's own Stripe account.

## Pricing (Manifest Desk)
- Weekend dropzone: $249/month (1 aircraft, 3 desk logins, 2% on in-app top-ups only).
- Full-time dropzone: $399/month (up to 3 aircraft, 10 desk logins, staff pay and payroll export, 1.5% on in-app top-ups only).
- Big operations: from $699/month (unlimited aircraft and logins, several dropzones on one login, 1% on in-app top-ups only).
- Pay yearly and get two months free. No lock-in, cancel anytime. The first 10 founding dropzones get 30% off year one.
- No fee on cash or card payments taken at the desk.

## How to get it
- Jumpers: download Manifest free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6778510429 (iPhone). Android is in the making.
- Dropzones: see https://www.jumpmanifest.com/dropzones/ or email andre@manifestjump.com to book a demo.
